content: Hello! This is Lisa from the Maplewood Community Fundraiser team. How can I assist with your donation or any questions today?
Hi Lisa, I just sent my contribution for the block party supplies via Zelle. Want to make sure it went through.

Thank you, I see a Zelle transfer of $75 from the account ending in 3421 under the name Samuel P. O'Brien. It arrived at 2:43 PM with memo 'Maplewood Party - Apt 204.' That matches your details, correct?
Yes, that's me. Samuel.p.obrien@gmail.com and I'm in Apt 204. Glad it worked. Is there a receipt or something I should keep?

Absolutely! I've just emailed a confirmation to samuel.p.obrien@gmail.com. Your transaction ID is ZL20240615-8472. Please save it for your records. If you need anything for reimbursement, let me know.
Thanks! Is my donation counted toward the urgent pizza order for this weekend, or do I need to notify anyone else?

You're all set, your $75 donation is earmarked for Saturday's pizza order, which we're finalizing by 5:00 PM today. No further action needed on your part. Just watch for a text from 347-555-0193 if there are updates about delivery.

Happy to help, Samuel! If you have any other questions about your Zelle transfer or the fundraiser, just reply to this thread or call our main number, (718) 555-3267. Thanks again for your timely support!
